text.p: SARAJEVO, May 2 (REUTER) - These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President of oposition Social Democratic Party (SDP) Zlatko Lagumdzija protests to international community's officials in Bosnia because none of the perpetrators who stoned two buses carrying refugees during a recent visit to the disputed town of Brcko were identified and punished.
- By forming a coalition with four opposition parties, ruling Moslem Party of Democratic Action (SDA) improves its image while opposition secures its survival, daily says in a commentary.

- Moslem chairman of the collective Bosnian presidency, Alija Izetbegovic, condemns recent attacks on Catholic churches in Bosnia saying only cowards can act in such way. -- Sarajevo newsroom +387-71-663-864
